// Kotlin Gradle Plugin resolves and unpacks the Kotlin/Native bundle on every build, even when Kotlin/Native is installed,
// so the Gradle environment would have to keep the bundle and its unpacked copy next to the installation.
// The bundle configuration is used only to install Kotlin/Native, so it is left empty when the installation exists.
// Checked with these Kotlin versions, other versions are left as they are.
val kotlinVersionsWithRedundantBundleResolution = setOf("2.3.21")

val konanDataDir = System.getenv("KONAN_DATA_DIR")?.let(::File) ?: File(System.getProperty("user.home"), ".konan")
val unlistedVersionReported = java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean()

fun isKotlinNativeInstalled(version: String): Boolean =
    konanDataDir.listFiles { file -> file.name.startsWith("kotlin-native-prebuilt-") && file.name.endsWith("-$version") }
        .orEmpty()
        .any { File(it, "provisioned.ok").isFile }

allprojects {
    configurations.matching { it.name == "kotlinNativeBundleConfiguration" }.configureEach {
        withDependencies {
            val version = singleOrNull { it.name == "kotlin-native-prebuilt" }?.version ?: return@withDependencies
            if (version !in kotlinVersionsWithRedundantBundleResolution) {
                // The Gradle environment removes the bundle anyway, so builds would download and unpack it again
                if (unlistedVersionReported.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
                    println("##teamcity[message text='Kotlin/Native $version is not checked in kotlin-native-bundle.init.gradle.kts, its bundle is resolved again' status='WARNING']")
                }
            } else if (isKotlinNativeInstalled(version)) {
                logger.info("Kotlin/Native $version is installed, skipping resolution of the bundle")
                clear()
            }
        }
    }
}
